name: Tragacanth
aliases: E413, INS 413, tragacanth, gum tragacanth, tragacanth gum
what_is: A plant gum obtained from Astragalus species and used as a thickener, stabiliser and emulsifying texturiser, identified in the EU as E413.
why_botia: Tragacanth is the natural exudate of a shrub from the Middle East and has been used since antiquity, in confectionery and pharmacy. It swells in water and thickens; it is not absorbed intact and part of it ferments in the intestine. It is one of the most expensive gums, so it appears mainly in specific uses, such as cake decoration. JECFA did not see a need to set a numerical limit.
